title: Start from zero
summary: Understand an assistant, use a small testing example, ask clear questions, and supply useful context before moving into specialist subjects.
prerequisite: No previous AI knowledge. Reading needs only a browser; guided demonstrations use your existing Codex or Claude Code.
outcome: Explain what an assistant can and cannot establish, scope a small request, and check its response against evidence.
after: Choose AI in everyday SDET work for practical use, or Building agents for the engineering route.

title: AI in everyday SDET work
summary: Move from a small repository task to meaningful tests, review, reusable skills, and reliable evaluation. Use the tools you already have.
prerequisite: Start from zero, or comfort with prompts, context, and the difference between generated text and execution evidence.
outcome: Use AI for bounded test changes and failure investigation while independently checking results and keeping private data safe.
after: Deepen skills, MCP, context, or evaluation through their subject tracks. Choose an optional workplace lab when you want independent practice.

title: Building controlled agents
audience: From assistant use to agent engineering
summary: Connect tools and MCP, understand a controlled loop, ground answers in evidence, then handle recovery and delegation.
prerequisite: Start from zero. Comfort opening a repository and asking your assistant to explain a small script; optional runnable labs require their listed setup.
outcome: Describe and inspect a bounded agent system, understand its tool permissions, and trace failures instead of trusting a successful demo.
after: Choose the Operate and evaluate path before deploying a real workflow. The complete student harness and MCP labs are available as optional implementation practice.

title: Operate and evaluate AI systems
summary: Test behavior and evidence, constrain permissions, investigate failures, and make measured release decisions. Includes the problems that demos rarely show.
prerequisite: Building controlled agents and Start from zero, or equivalent understanding of tool contracts, MCP, bounded loops, retrieval, and delegation. Reading requires no production deployment.
outcome: Recognize leakage, unsafe authority, partial failure, weak graders, and misleading metrics; choose evidence for a release or rollback.
after: Choose one retained incident exercise, then a capstone when ready. Their answers remain behind recorded attempts and an explicit reveal.
